basis_mismatch_both_columns.description: Basis unreadable, both columns printed: the user picks the basis; each column is shown on its own.

basis_mismatch_one_column.description: Label says per serving but only the per-100 g object has values: one shared column, its basis is the doubt.

category_check.description: Printed per 100 ml but the guess was not a drink: the user must pick the category.

category_unknown.description: No category guess: the user must pick the category.

clean.description: Per-100 g label, every unit printed: nothing to ask.

derived_basis_mismatch.description: Label says per 100 g but only per-serving values: derived and in doubt; the per-serving column is shared.

derived_from_serving.description: Only a per-serving column with a readable serving: per 100 g is derived, so the serving size must be ticked for anything to be stored.

devanagari.description: Hindi ingredient and allergen text: kept in its script, nothing extra to ask.

implausible_value.description: More sugar than carbohydrate: the save is rejected until the user fixes it.

low_confidence.description: Low extraction confidence: no extra question; the stored confidence stays low.

unit_unconfirmed_sodium_per_100g.description: Sodium printed as "0.4" with no unit: the user picks mg or g (no tick).

unit_unconfirmed_sodium_per_serving.description: Unit-less sodium on the per-serving column only: the unit is still required when saving the per-100 g column (R19).

upper_bound_protein_per_100g.description: Protein printed as "<0.5 g": stored only when ticked.

upper_bound_protein_per_serving.description: Protein "<0.5 g" on the per-serving column: asked whichever column is saved (R19).
